gravity_fmg_color_option.decision: Color reset alone partially improves restart. Combining it with opt-in repeat initial FMG after restart reaches approximately 1e-14 in tested static/adaptive AMR. Both defaults remain false.

gravity_fmg_restart_repeat_option.decision: Combined opt-ins restore approximately 1e-14 restart reproducibility in local static and adaptive AMR; keep both default false and collapse production guard.

wor25_strict_preconditioner_trials.decision: Two MG V-cycles reduce the strict second-solve residual floor but do not reach 1e-10 at 400 iterations; three V-cycles are worse. Restart 40 does not change the result. No default change.
